ants.definition: n social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers
ants.translation: n. 蚂蚁, 蚁（ant的复数形式）

antsy.definition: s. nervous and unable to relax
antsy.translation: a. 热锅上的蚂蚁般的,坐立不安的
